title: sloisel/MPE-Formal
summary: Machine-checked proofs of three probabilistic convergence theorems for restarted Minimal Polynomial Extrapolation (MPE) applied to nonlinear fixed-point iterations. Dithered restarts keep the error below the doubly exponential schedule delta^(theta^m), for any theta in (1,2), from every starting point -- the breakdown set included -- with an explicit failure-probability exponent over the dither; in the root sense the convergence order is at least theta.
